title: Overhead Stowage Compartment Shell — Removal

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Removal of an overhead stowage compartment shell from one bay, covering the tie-rod release sequence, the bin light disconnection and the placard record that has to be kept with the bay.

sections.purpose: To remove an overhead stowage compartment shell from a single bay for replacement, for repair or for access to the structure above it.
sections.job_setup_note: The cabin must be out of service and the bay emptied. The shell must be supported on the bin lifting aid before any tie rod is released; the shell is light but awkward and will swing on the remaining rod. The bay placard must be recorded before it is removed, because the placard belongs to the bin fitted and not to the bay. Two persons are needed.
sections.procedure: Make sure that the cabin is out of service and that the bay and the seats below it are clear. Remove the electrical power and put the warning notices in position. Record the load placard fitted to the bay and keep the record with the bay number. Open the bin door and support it on the lifting aid. WARNING: DO NOT STAND ON A SEAT OR AN ARMREST TO REACH THE BIN. USE THE CABIN WORKING PLATFORM. Remove the sidewall and ceiling trim panels adjacent to the bay. Disconnect the bin light assembly at functional item 47DL and insulate the free end. Fit the bin lifting aid under the shell and take the weight. CAUTION: RELEASE THE FORWARD TIE ROD FIRST AND THE AFT TIE ROD LAST. RELEASING THE AFT ROD FIRST LETS THE SHELL ROTATE ONTO THE CEILING PANEL. Release the forward tie rod at the ceiling attachment and lower it clear. Release the outboard tie rod. Release the aft tie rod while both persons support the shell. Remove the floating nuts EN194394K6 and the washers EN557515-96 at the sidewall attachment. Lower the shell clear of the cabin and put it on the padded trolley. Examine the ceiling attachment fittings for elongation and record any finding.
sections.close_out: Make sure that the bin light feed is insulated and secured. Make sure that no fastener remains loose at the ceiling attachment. Fit the temporary aperture cover at the open bay. Keep the recorded placard with the bay so that the correct placard is fitted at reinstallation. Remove the working platform. Record the removal, the bay number, the placard fitted and any finding at the attachment fittings.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The tie-rod positions differ on aircraft post MOD-111375.

safety_precautions: Do not stand on a seat or an armrest to reach the bin.
Support the shell on the lifting aid before any tie rod is released.
Release the forward tie rod first and the aft tie rod last.
